snippet.title: GraveDiggers | Playtest Trailer - Co-op Horror with Cats
snippet.description:
Bury the dead before the curse grows. GraveDiggers is a 1-6 player online co-op horror game where you and up to five friends play undertaker cats with one job: bury the dead.
Play the free playtest and wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4383310/GraveDiggers/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=trailer_oct26
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/6gWfe4epyr

Find the bodies, keep your coffins away from a necromancer, fight what stands in your way, dig the graves and eat cheese whenever you can.

ONE DAY, ONE BODY
The day repeats until the job is done. If the sun rises on an unburied body, the curse level goes up and you start over.
- Find the body. It's somewhere on the map. You'll have to explore to find it.
- Put it in the coffin. The coffin is heavy and slows you down, so plan your route.
- Find the cemetery. It's hidden in the landscape. Agree on a direction before you move.
- Dig the grave and bury the body before the day ends.

THE MIST COMES AT MIDNIGHT
At midnight, a sphere of mist starts closing in on the map. The safe area gets smaller every minute, so you can't take your time. Finish the job before it reaches you.

WHAT'S OUT THERE
- Many enemies, each with its own behavior. Learn how they move before they learn how you do.
- Landmarks to explore. They hold loot and useful items, and they're rarely safe.
- Secrets hidden across the map for players who leave the main path.

UP TO 6 PLAYERS
GraveDiggers is a cooperative multiplayer game. Split up to scout, carry the coffin together, and dig while someone holds off what comes out of the fog. With a full crew of six, plans fall apart fast, and that's when it gets fun.

PLAYTEST: STILL IN DEVELOPMENT
GraveDiggers is in active development and this Playtest is an early version. Coming soon: landmarks with puzzles, new events, new enemies. You'll find bugs and unfinished parts. Tell us what scared you, what annoyed you and what you want to see next on our Discord. Your feedback shapes the game.

Early Access: April 2027. Grab your shovel and your friends. Night is coming.
